name: Gemini Live
summary: The Gemini Live API is Google's stateful WebSocket API for realtime voice and video sessions with Gemini models. It streams audio, images and text in and speaks back, with barge-in, tool use and Google Search grounding. The current model is Gemini 3.8 Live, released in September 2026.
facts: 16 kHz PCM in, 24 kHz PCM out
Yes, on the Gemini API free tier
goodFor: Voice plus camera or screen input
Agents that call tools while still talking
watchOut: Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products
Use ephemeral tokens, not API keys, for client connections
Older Live models carry fixed discontinuation dates
